sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:21

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:21:1
items.html:
Because they are in one vessel, this vessel has no strength to bear the light: For until the world of Nekudim there is in all the ten Sefirot no more than one vessel; and although we call the other Sefirot here by the name vessels, this is only by way of borrowing, in order to soothe the ear, as the ARI wrote above, Part 4, Chapter 1; study it there well.
And this is the cause of the refinement and the departure of the lights of the first expansion of Akudim, and likewise of the reaching and not reaching of the second expansion of Akudim, as the ARI wrote above, Part 4, Chapter 1, item 3: that when ten inner lights and ten surrounding lights are connected and joined in one vessel, etc., they strike one another and clash with one another, etc.; see there. For by this cause the coarseness in the screen was refined and the lights departed. And in this same way all these ten goings out and ten comings in that were here in the second expansion are likewise from that same cause: that the surrounding light and the inner light, connected together at their root in the Malchut of the Rosh [head], strike one another in going out from there to the Guf [body], because the screen prevents the surrounding light from expanding to its place in the Guf, that is, from the Tabur downward; and therefore it refines the screen, and the screen cannot bear and delimit the inner light within the vessels, and the lights depart and return, as written before us. And see the Inner Light, Part 4, Chapter 1, item 7.
